messages:
Sasha: FYI pushed canary image for service-foo to eu-staging but deploy-bot flagged provenance->tag mismatch :eyes:

deploy-bot: [automated] Image push accepted but attestation label != release tag. provenance-attest: failed-to-match-label. holding promotion.

Jakob: Wait, what's the label drift? We tag with `release/v2.3.1` but image was produced with label `build-20260315-547`? Did CI change tagging strategy?

maya: CI changed to use ephemeral build labels last week, I thought release pipeline re-tags using `gcrane tag` in release job.

ci-bot: The build artifact digest is sha256:abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890. Original tag `build-20260315-547` exists and has attestation. Retag step failed due to rate-limit on gcr.

sasha: I saw deploybot hold because attestation metadata has `repository_label=build-20260315-547` while release metadata expects `release/v2.3.1`. Attestation verification won't allow promotion.

jakob: Options: 1) re-run retag+attest job and republish (risking another rate-limit hit), 2) pin the release to the existing digest and update release notes, 3) rollback canary to previous digest.

ops-oncall: Prefer pin+notes to avoid re-publish in middle of change window. We can do republish during maintenance window later.

release-manager: Agree with pin. Update release notes to indicate canary uses pinned digest sha256:abcd1234..., and add follow-up ticket to standardize tagging. I'll draft note.

maya: I'll update the release PR and push a `docker tag` with the pinned digest in the release manifest.

ci-bot: Command we recommend:
```
# retag locally and push (if we republish later)
gcrane tag gcr.io/redwood-inference/service-foo@sha256:abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890 gcr.io/redwood-inference/service-foo:release/v2.3.1
gcloud artifacts docker images add-tag --project=redwood-inference gcr.io/redwood-inference/service-foo@sha256:abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890 release/v2.3.1
```

deploy-bot: Hold remains until release-manager confirms. React with :thumbsup: when done.

release-manager: Drafted note and created ticket INF-4123 for tagging standardization. Will notify when pinned tag goes live. :spiral_notepad:

sasha: ok marking canary as pinned, will continue monitoring latency and errors for next 2 hours. :mag:

ops-oncall: Thanks — moving this to post-release checklist. If republish is needed, schedule it outside the release window. :calendar:
thread_text_summary: Canary image push hit attestation tag mismatch due to CI ephemeral labels. Team decided to pin canary to digest and update release notes, add ticket to standardize tagging, avoid republish during change window.
